description: Fix review issues: unify DEMO_MODE to NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE everywhere, fix Tradovate CORS by adding server-side proxy route, fix silent success on network errors, add trades API route and fetch in production mode.
steps: Step 1: Unify env vars - change /api/metrics/route.ts, middleware.ts, auth.ts, and page.tsx to use NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE instead of DEMO_MODE. Update .env.example to remove the separate DEMO_MODE line.
Step 2: Create /api/tradovate/connect/route.ts as a server-side proxy for Tradovate auth to avoid CORS. Fix endpoint casing to accessTokenRequest (camelCase).
Step 3: Fix settings page to call /api/tradovate/connect instead of calling Tradovate directly. Fix error handling to NOT mark as connected on failure.
Step 4: Create /api/trades/route.ts that fetches trades for the authenticated user's accounts.
Step 5: Update TradesPageContent to fetch from /api/trades in production mode.
Step 6: Update DashboardOverview to fetch recent trades from /api/trades?limit=5 in production mode.
acceptance_criteria: Only NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE is used across all server and client code
The /api/tradovate/connect route proxies auth requests server-side (no CORS)
Settings page calls the internal proxy route, not Tradovate directly
On connection failure, error toast is shown and platform is NOT marked connected
The /api/trades route returns trades for the authenticated user
TradesPageContent fetches from /api/trades in production mode
verification: Run NODE_OPTIONS='' npx next build and confirm it succeeds
Run NODE_OPTIONS='' npx vitest run and confirm all tests pass
